subsections.sota_investigation_mission: IMF and other work turning AIS port calls and draught into trade indicators, and their validation against customs or port statistics.
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: Validation is done for countries and for bulk or tanker trade; no published validation for Ro-Ro or rail ferries; port polygons and type mapping unpublished.

subsections.bridge_to_our_method: We test PortWatch against port-level official figures on a corridor dominated by ferries.

subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Sentinel-1 ship detection (CFAR-type detectors, mass processing, deep learning benchmarks, global maps).
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: Global maps exclude near-shore water and the Caspian; harbour detection is hard because ships merge with quays.
limitation_search_queries: satellite mapping industrial activity at sea
subsections.bridge_to_our_method: We use a simple change detector against a per-pixel reference in two zones and report precision per zone.
